The '''3rd Group''' was a unit of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that served in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The unit fielded standard [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class territorial defense starfighters]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]].
